LanguageData.SEC_DiaNode_Secretary_FirstContact_Confi: Are you sure to leave with the secretaries? Your colonists will follow the secretaries to a settlement under their administration, where they will be arranged to live peacefully and prosperously somewhere — or perhaps leave this planet. Their story here will come to an end. (Game Over)

Are you sure to attack the secretaries? Your relationship with the local Secretary Nexus will immediately become hostile. If your colony is not located under thick roof or protected by shield, it is highly not recommended that you choose to do this.

LanguageData.SEC_EndingScene_FollowSecretaries_Intro: You've left the wilderness with the help of the secretaries!
LanguageData.SEC_EndingScene_FollowSecretaries_Desc: You followed the secretaries farther and farther away, and the wreckage of the drop pods gradually disappeared beyond the horizon. Though you felt uneasy about having trusted so easily a group of rabbit-eared clones, the secretaries' warmth toward you along the way slowly melted away that distrust. You realized that they were not the cold, faceless, identical clones you had seen in holodramas — they had their own personalities and hobbies, they cried and laughed, and they were quite talkative, enthusiastically telling you about the life, culture, and cuisine of Alfaus. Along the way, they also took in some refugees in situations similar to yours, though those people hadn't fallen out of the sky. Eventually, one morning, you climbed a small nameless hill and looked down upon an orderly little town. According to the secretaries, that was the refugee camp they had mentioned. As the others followed the secretaries down the hill one by one, you remained at the summit, gazing into the distance. For the first time since you had arrived on this unknown rimworld, a small glimmer of hope for the life ahead stirred within your heart.
